doc: Where scripts/jobs_sources.mjs looks for roles beyond LinkedIn alerts. Public, unauthenticated JSON only: Greenhouse boards-api, Lever postings API, Ashby posting-api, YC public job pages (Inertia data-page JSON on ycombinator.com/jobs/role/*, robots allows), and the HN 'Who is hiring?' thread via the public Algolia HN API. Getro VC boards are NOT polled: api.getro.com robots.txt is 'Disallow: /' and the board robots.txt asks for their paid API instead (checked 2026-11-02). Company slugs were verified live on 2026-11-02 (each returned jobs); a slug that starts failing is reported, never guessed at. Seeded for fit: AI products, legal/contracts AI, decision and data tools, devtools, fintech and regulated domains, NYC metro or remote.

titles.doc: A title must match include and must not match exclude (case-insensitive). The lane name becomes the row's alertQuery, which the role page maps to an archetype (forward -> FDE, applied -> Applied AI, product -> AI-Native Product Engineer).

include.pattern: applied ai|\bai engineer\b|\bllm engineer\b|\bagent(?:s|ic)? engineer|member of technical staff.{0,20}applied|\bai solutions (?:engineer|architect)

titles.exclude: \bintern(?:ship)?\b|new grad|\bjunior\b|\bjr\.?\b|\bassociate\b|apprentice|product marketing|product design(?:er)?\b|product support|product operations|product analyst|engineering manager|manager, (?:product )?engineering|\bdirector of engineering|\bcontract(?:or)?\b|\bpart[- ]time\b|^\s*(?:senior |sr\.? )?manager\b|engagement manager|technical program manager|\btpm\b|product sales|strategy (?:&|and) operations|\bgtm\b|https?:

location.doc: Split a multi-location string on ; | / 'or'. Keep when any part is NY metro, or remote and not tied to another region, or a US-wide label with no city (United States, US, North America). The title is checked for drop_region too ('(United Kingdom)', 'EMEA'). A bare 'Remote' part counts only when the string names no other region, or also names the US.

yc.doc: Public role pages; each embeds its listing as JSON.

hn.doc: Latest 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' story by user whoishiring; top-level comments only.
